blocks.text: Although not necessarily one you’ll need often, sewer repair is a critical service for your Castle Hills, TX, home. You’ll want to address any sewer line issues as quickly as possible, as they can be incredibly damaging if left unchecked.

Fortunately, the sewer line replacement and repair experts at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air are here to help. Our team can locate any damage in your sewer pipes and fix them quickly with as little damage to your yard as possible. Here’s what you need to know about sewer services and how to tell when you need them.
Sewer Line Replacement and Repair Services

If you’re like most homeowners, you probably don’t give much thought to your sewer lines unless there is an issue, that is. These pipes carry wastewater away from your home, so they are highly important, even if not always front of mind.

Because these pipes are located fairly deep underground, they can sometimes sustain damage from tree roots or as your home’s foundation shifts and settles. This underground location also means that it isn’t always readily visible when one springs a leak, so it is important to know the most common warning signs so you can deal with any problems right away.

items: Smell of sewage in your yard or from drains
Puddles or soggy patches in your lawn
Increased pest presence in your yard
Sluggish drains in your home or yard
More frequent drain clogs or backups

blocks.text: Any of these warning signs on their own might not necessarily indicate a sewer line problem, but multiple signs occurring at the same time make it increasingly more likely. Be sure to call our plumbers right away to assess your sewer lines.

Even if the problem is not with the sewer pipes, there could be issues elsewhere in your plumbing system. It is better to check and be sure to minimize the risk of costly water damage to your home and yard.
